name: Shadehold
contract: Holds the top road alone. Win your duel or stay even, keep your Needles standing, and arrive at the big fights as a front line.

name: Grovehunter
contract: Has no road. Hunt the camps in the Dialwood, catch enemies who walk too far up a road, and lead your team to the big objectives.

name: Dialcross
contract: Holds the short centre road across the Seat. Clear your wave fast, then cross to a side road and turn its fight before the enemy can follow.

name: Shaftlight
contract: Shares the bottom road with your Lampglass. Last-hit every Wick you can, stay behind your front line, and become the team's steady damage late in the match.

name: Lampglass
contract: Shares the bottom road and leaves the gold to your Shaftlight. Shield and heal them, start or stop fights, and light up the map so your team sees danger first.
